hero.name: Evelym Marinho
hero.tagline: Backend engineer with 6+ years building scalable APIs, high availability systems and Python solutions. Author of international research on automation and software quality.

about.label: About
about.title: Who I am
about.bio_1: Backend Software Engineer with over 6 years of solid experience in the Python ecosystem, specializing in building scalable and highly available RESTful APIs. An expert in frameworks such as FastAPI and Django, I rigorously apply TDD, Pytest, Clean Code and SOLID on a daily basis.
about.bio_2: Author of international research on test automation and CI/CD, with publications in ACM (ICSCA 2026) and IEEE (SEAI 2024). Robust experience in containerized environments with Docker and Kubernetes, integrating relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases. Total focus on performance, security and constant innovation.

items.title: E2E-CIFlow
items.description: Automated End-to-End testing process integrated into CI/CD pipelines using Playwright and GitHub Actions. Research published in the ACM Digital Library (ICSCA 2026), demonstrating how the approach speeds up deploys and reduces fault detection time.

items.title: Microservices API Gateway
items.description: High-performance REST APIs for global products at Sidia, built in Python with microservices architecture. Deployment in Kubernetes with automated CI/CD pipelines and test coverage with TDD and Pytest.

items.title: ETL Pipeline for Retail
items.description: High-availability system for processing large volumes of retail data at Bemol Digital. Robust ETL with optimization of SQL queries in PostgreSQL and caching with Redis, integrating APIs and interfaces in agile cycles.

items.title: Agile Blueprint Model
items.description: Agile modeling method for the software development process with version increment. Research published at the IEEE 4th International Conference on Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (SEAI 2024).
